issue: Can a federal court of appeals hear a habeas petitioner's cross-appeal arguments on an alternative claim that the district court declined to certify for appeal, when the state appeals a grant of habeas relief?

sides.position: No jurisdiction to hear the uncertified cross-appeal claim absent a proper certificate of appealability.
cases: Mathias v. Superintendent Frackville SCI, 876 F.3d 462 (3d Cir. 2017)

sides.position: Certification is unnecessary; the appellate court may reach the uncertified cross-appeal claim.

quote: When a state appeals a grant of habeas relief, our sister circuits are split on whether federal appellate courts have jurisdiction to hear a petitioner's arguments on cross-appeal about an alternative habeas claim that has not been certified.
cite: Mark Hartman v. Dave Yost, No. 23-3365 (6th Cir. 2025)
